title: Review repository quality and prepare an improvement plan
description: Audit current features and implementation at b319103, reproduce priority defects, prepare the dated Markdown review and phased plan, and record scoped follow-up issues. Preserve unrelated work.
close_reason: Completed the source review, local baseline checks and synthetic reproductions; wrote the Markdown plan, validated the focused OpenSpec draft and recorded 12 scoped follow-up issues. Implementation remains open in those issues.

title: Establish hermetic tests and enforce staged quality gates
description: Review Q15: local baseline is 219 passed/22 failed/50 skipped at 43.4% line coverage, affected by optional deps, home config, and editable iterabledata; registry tests are not collected by default; core tests swallow failures. Extend improve-metacrafter-ci.
acceptance_criteria: Base and optional dependency jobs are deterministic with no user config/live network; registry tests are collected; swallowing tests assert real outcomes; wheel tests run outside source checkout; blocking lint/type/coverage gates reflect a measured baseline and docs build on PRs.

title: Finish core architecture extraction with compatibility checks
description: Review Q16: core.py is 2367 lines, commands.py 1040, match_dict 310; core.py/core package collision uses a dynamic import shim; CLI apps still live in core despite checklist claims. Extend refactor-metacrafter-core after result regression coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Shared scan service/source adapters/output writers/config resolution replace duplicated flows; legacy and top-level CrafterCmd imports remain valid; golden reports and exit codes are preserved; library initialization does not force global logging configuration.

title: Develop report diff, PII inventory, rule tooling, and policy features
description: Plan features F01-F07: deterministic report comparison; consolidated PII inventory with completeness; rule lint/test/explain; policy checks for pipelines; sample-based rule drafts; calibrated evaluation/benchmarks; opt-in integration adapters. Refine add-ecosystem-product-features into approved slices after result/schema/sampling foundations.
acceptance_criteria: Each slice has an approved focused OpenSpec, measurable user outcome, dependencies and acceptance criteria from the improvement plan; suggested rules require review and negative examples; no UI/platform expansion proceeds without a demonstrated consumer need.

title: Reconcile registry configuration, documentation, and release claims
description: Review Q17 and roadmap drift: registry config getter is not used throughout result URLs/client; old roadmap lists delivered work; untracked proposals/check scripts are pending; architecture docs refer to missing methods. Update docs against executable examples and reconcile proposal status without copying stale cross-repo counts.
acceptance_criteria: One registry resolver controls SDK/API/LLM/client links and optional cache enrichment; docs examples pass; current and proposed capabilities are separated; supported format/Python matrices are verified; completed changes are archived only after release verification.

title: Fix statistics mapping and preserve valid field coverage
description: Review findings Q01-Q02: CrafterCmd.scan_data maps Analyzer column 13 (minval) to dictvalues and drops later statistics; Analyzer ignores one-character/numeric keys and scalar arrays. See REPOSITORY_REVIEW_AND_IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md and draft improve-scan-result-integrity.
acceptance_criteria: Named statistics agree across SDK/API/serialized output; tests cover numeric min/max, dictionary values, one-character and numeric keys, scalar arrays, missing fields, and path collisions.

title: Ship built-in rules in wheels and verify standalone installations
description: Review Q03: the 0.0.6 wheel built from b319103 contains zero YAML files; DEFAULT_RULEPATH is relative to the working directory. Include package resources, declare direct runtime dependencies, and constrain package discovery. Extend modernize-metacrafter-packaging.
acceptance_criteria: Wheel and sdist contain built-in YAML; installs scan synthetic email/UUID data from an unrelated directory with no user config or extended pack; each optional extra gets a smoke test.

title: Repair SQL schema selection, quoting, and connection cleanup
description: Review Q04: converting quoted_name to str does not quote identifiers; schema is not included in SELECT; same-name tables overwrite reports; native DuckDB also omits schema qualification. Replace SQL strings with dialect-aware constructs and redact connection URLs.
acceptance_criteria: Reserved words, spaces, mixed case, and duplicate table names in separate schemas work; PostgreSQL/DuckDB select the requested schema; supported dialects compile valid limits; failures close connections and mask credentials.

title: Unify report serialization and catalog export outcomes
description: Review Q05-Q07: saved reports use fields but exporters expect data; bulk JSON concatenates documents; PII metadata is ignored by exporters; write failures are counted as success. Extend the result integrity proposal and exporter contracts.
acceptance_criteria: File/SQL/bulk reports round-trip through each exporter; bulk JSON/YAML/CSV are parseable; explicit is_pii survives export; failed writes appear in errors and never increase confirmed-success counts; reruns preserve existing metadata.

title: Align HTTP scan options and initialize dependencies once
description: Review Q08: API ignores confidence/fields/date/stat options sent by client, returns 500 for valid JSON of wrong shape, and factory routes recreate dependencies unless initialize_rules is explicitly called. Extend expand-metacrafter-llm-platform.
acceptance_criteria: SDK and API classify the same input/options identically; invalid shape and limits receive 400; oversized bodies receive 413; dependencies initialize once per worker; health/readiness and WSGI deployment are documented.

title: Make rule validation, precedence, and threshold semantics explicit
description: Review Q09-Q10: perfect value matches are rejected at confidence=100; boolean is_pii is compared with a string; missing validators degrade to unchecked patterns; duplicate IDs are first-wins and filesystem order is unspecified. Extend ecosystem alignment checks.
acceptance_criteria: Inclusive finite confidence ranges, consistent empty-value policy, typed YAML, strict diagnostics, deterministic sorted loading, explicit collision policy, and correct PII propagation have regression fixtures; validator failures cannot silently increase trust.

title: Registry-driven modernization to 1.0.0
description: Implement devdocs/MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md (accepted 2026-11-05): registry as source of truth, detection engine v2, report v2, agent interfaces, LLM rework, ecosystem contract. Roadmap: openspec/ROADMAP.md.
acceptance_criteria: All seven OpenSpec changes of the plan are implemented, released as 1.0.0 and archived.

title: Implement refactor-metacrafter-foundation
description: Phase 0. Python >=3.10, pydantic v2 API, source/server extras, metacrafter-rules as required dependency, delete in-repo rules/, package-resolved default pack, target layout docs, archive metacrafter-llm. OpenSpec: openspec/changes/refactor-metacrafter-foundation.
acceptance_criteria: openspec tasks complete; CI green on 3.10-3.13 with and without extras; wheel scans CSV outside checkout.

title: Implement add-registry-integration
description: Phase 1. RegistryAdapter over metacrafter_registry.Registry with verified cache and offline mode; configurable base URL; canonical id resolution (aliases, deprecated); match enrichment; registry-based PII with pii_source; metadata filters; provenance; rules check --registry. Supersedes Codex update-registry-resolution (metacrafter-13). Blocked externally on metacrafter-registry PyPI publication (HTTP fallback until then). OpenSpec: openspec/changes/add-registry-integration.
acceptance_criteria: openspec tasks complete; URLs honour registry_url; no alias ids in output; adapter tests offline.

title: Implement update-detection-engine
description: Phase 2. Rule format v2 schema; match: regex and match: registry; checksum:<algo> validators; honour priority/deprecated/validator/fieldrule/minlen; registry-derived detectors (default stable); scoring model v1 with evidence; qddate crosswalk; compiled ruleset cache; --pack. OpenSpec: openspec/changes/update-detection-engine.
acceptance_criteria: openspec tasks complete; recall >=90% on registry positives for covered types; 0 accepted negatives for checksum types; no throughput regression.

title: Implement add-report-v2
description: Phase 3. Typed report v2 with published JSON Schema; --format legacy; --format md; catalog exporters driven by registry data; export labels (presidio, google_dlp, dpv, purview); Frictionless export. OpenSpec: openspec/changes/add-report-v2.
acceptance_criteria: openspec tasks complete; all CLI/SDK/API reports validate against the schema; exporters contain no datatype lists.

title: Implement add-agent-interfaces
description: Phase 4a. metacrafter mcp (classify_columns, scan_file, scan_sql, explain_match, list_rules) with allowlists and limits; skills metacrafter-scan and metacrafter-rule-author; FastAPI HTTP v2 with OpenAPI, health/ready, limits, v1 compatibility route; llms.txt for docs. OpenSpec: openspec/changes/add-agent-interfaces.
acceptance_criteria: openspec tasks complete; SDK, HTTP and MCP return identical reports; path traversal and raw SQL URLs rejected.

title: Implement update-llm-classification
description: Phase 4b. Registry shortlist via identify/search; corpus from registry with manifest fingerprint; negative examples as counter-evidence; structured output constrained to shortlist; rules-first hybrid with cache; OpenAI-compatible presets plus Anthropic; PII-aware disclosure. Builds on Codex update-llm-trust-and-offline-index (metacrafter-9). OpenSpec: openspec/changes/update-llm-classification.
acceptance_criteria: openspec tasks complete; invented ids rejected; no raw PII values to remote providers by default.

title: Implement add-ecosystem-contract-tests
description: Phase 5 (parallel). Key resolution gate in CI; rules test --registry-examples with thresholds; ecosystem.lock; weekly compatibility workflow against rules and registry HEAD; synthetic detection benchmark. Supersedes July add-ecosystem-alignment-workflow. OpenSpec: openspec/changes/add-ecosystem-contract-tests.
acceptance_criteria: openspec tasks complete; CI fails on unresolved rule keys and on accepted negatives for checksum types.

title: Bound scan memory and record sampling provenance
description: Review Q11: file reader materializes all records before limit; Analyzer and dict_to_columns retain full-cardinality data; first-N matching differs from whole-input statistics. Draft add-bounded-scan-sampling before implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Head and seeded reservoir modes have documented read/stat/classification scopes; retained records and cardinality state are bounded; wide/large/nested fixtures measure RSS and preserve confidence denominators; reports include effective sampling options and counts.

title: Harden LLM classification, offline embeddings, and secret handling
description: Review Q12-Q14: local LLMs still require OpenAI embeddings; unknown IDs are accepted; failed initialization falls back silently; index reuse only checks count; PII and nested samples are lost; full config/API keys and database URLs can enter debug output. Extend expand-metacrafter-llm-platform.
acceptance_criteria: Secrets are redacted; external sample transmission is configurable; offline stack makes zero cloud calls; result IDs/finite confidence are validated; explicit fallback policy is reported; index fingerprints and atomic rebuilds prevent stale/corrupt retrieval.
